cues: Stanza four: having left her inherited ground, she claims all ground.
She is a blossom of all the soils of the earth: soil without history, so no ancestors to obey; without a future, so no destiny mapped out; soil without edges, so no borders.
Then stanza five is a single line, standing alone: the climax.
All in me, as life was in me.
The hide and seek is over; the self and life are the same size.
And the trailing dots refuse to close.
